experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.text: Plugins run out of process in a sandboxed host. The plugin runtime is experimental and not ready for production use; only install plugins you trust.

title.platformUnsupported: Plugins cannot run on this platform
title.notBuilt: Plugins are not available: the agent was built without plugin support
title.notEnabled: Plugins are not available: they are turned off in the agent
title.unavailable: Plugins are not available right now
title.agentNotRunning: Plugins are not available: the agent is not running
title.agentTooOld: Plugins are not available: the running agent is too old

hint.platformUnsupported: Plugins can be installed and inspected here, but not enabled or run: the plugin sandbox is only verified on macOS, Linux and Windows.
hint.notBuilt: Plugins need an agent built with the `plugins` cargo feature.
hint.notEnabled: Start the agent without --disable-plugins (and without DECKPILOT_ENABLE_PLUGINS=0).
hint.unavailable: Unlock DeckPilot, or check the agent's log.
hint.agentNotRunning: Start it in Settings › Background Agent.
hint.agentTooOld: Restart it in Settings › Background Agent so that the agent of this release runs.

error.title: The registry could not be read

neverVerified.title: Registry not verified yet
neverVerified.text: Nothing can be installed until the registry has been verified.

stale.title: Registry stale
stale.text: Installed plugins keep running. Installing and updating are paused.

blocked.noRegistry: No plugin registry is configured in the agent (--plugin-registry).
blocked.stale: The registry is out of date; installing and updating are paused until it is checked again.
blocked.neverVerified: The registry has not been verified yet; nothing can be installed.

package.title: Install the plugin package?
package.description: DeckPilot installs it only if its bytes are a version the verified registry pins. Nothing is granted now: its permissions are shown for your consent before it can be enabled.

toast.uninstalledKeptSettings: {{name}} uninstalled; its settings are kept for a reinstall
toast.uninstalledKeptCredentials: {{name}} uninstalled; its credentials are kept for a reinstall
toast.uninstalledKeptBoth: {{name}} uninstalled; its settings and credentials are kept for a reinstall
toast.rolledBackPrevious: {{name}} rolled back to the previous version

core.title: Core functionality
core.none: Built into DeckPilot, not plugins; see Settings › Modules.

discover.installFileHint: Only a .dpplugin whose bytes the verified registry pins is accepted.

empty.title: No plugins to show
empty.registryError: The registry could not be read.
empty.noRegistry: No registry is configured in the agent.
empty.neverVerified: The registry has not been verified on this computer yet.

noMatch.title: No plugins found
noMatch.inCategory: No plugin in {{category}} matches your search.

updates.intro: Updates that ask for new permissions are never applied without your consent.
updates.none: All plugins are up to date

details.noVersion: No version can be installed: every version was withdrawn or does not run here.
details.installedFor: Installed for {{plugin}}; it is offered for removal once nothing needs it.
details.knownBefore: Installed here before as {{name}}, last version {{version}} ({{date}}). Actions that still use it say it is not installed.
details.storageHint: What the plugin keeps for itself in DeckPilot. It is deleted when the plugin is uninstalled.
details.permissionsHint: Each with the publisher's reason. DeckPilot asks for your consent before it installs anything.
details.actionsNotListed: The registry does not list a plugin's actions; they are shown here once it is installed.

installed.intro: Plugins run only while enabled, and only with the permissions you granted.

health.label: Health of {{name}}
health.crashes_one: The plugin host stopped {{count}} time since the agent started
health.crashes_other: The plugin host stopped {{count}} times since the agent started
health.lastFailed: The last action of this plugin failed

installed.notGranted_one: {{count}} permission not granted; calls that need it fail with “not permitted”.
installed.notGranted_other: {{count}} permissions not granted; calls that need them fail with “not permitted”.
installed.blockedHint: It cannot run or be enabled. Roll back, update or uninstall it.
installed.brokenBundledHint: Its files no longer match the copy that comes with DeckPilot. Reinstall it from that copy; its settings and your permission choices are kept.

removed.title: Removed DeckPilot plugins
removed.intro: Plugins that come with DeckPilot and that you uninstalled. Restore one to install DeckPilot's own copy again; settings you kept come back with it.

installed.cannotRunHint: It can be inspected, updated and uninstalled, but not enabled here.
installed.missingSettings_one: {{settings}} has no value and no default. Set it in Configure.
installed.missingSettings_other: {{settings}} have no value and no default. Set them in Configure.

staged.title: Version {{version}} waits for your consent
staged.text_one: It asks for {{count}} more permission. The current version keeps running until you decide.
staged.text_other: It asks for {{count}} more permissions. The current version keeps running until you decide.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.description: Stops the plugin and removes its files, its permissions, its records (including the version kept for rollback) and its storage. Its settings and credentials are deleted too, unless you keep them below.
uninstall.keepCredentialsLong: {{keep}} (stored secrets stay in DeckPilot until the plugin is installed again and uninstalled without keeping them)
